framingPolicy.sideProps: Large near left/right pieces may intentionally extend beyond the viewport. Original source silhouettes remain intact. Keep the inner40% open except explicit rear focal props above the ground.
framingPolicy.groundContact: Use measured center horizon; prop base overlaps ground by declared pixels.
framingPolicy.overscan: Review static crops only; arbitrary camera motion needs expanded source edges.

skybox.inside: Back wall or fixed room shell.
skybox.propBoundary: Movable or interchangeable pillars, bookshelves, stairs and furniture use separate prop PNGs.

props.description: Separate transparent PNGs for buildings, pillars, bookshelves, stairs, rocks, trees and furniture.

ground.description: Separate floor surface, transparent above the ground plane, drawn over prop bases.

weather.description: Independent weather tint and effects; outdoors by default.

floorProps.description: Separate rugs and flat floor decorations, drawn above ground and below actors.

timeOfDayFilters.selection: Choose one day or night tint; tune opacity independently of weather.
